title: LLM-Based Hierarchical Coordinated Control with Continuation-Aware Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15041v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coordinating multiple interacting units in complex engineering systems is challenging when system interactions are difficult to model, operational information is heterogeneous, and low-level actions must satisfy strict constraints. We propose an LLM-based hierarchical framework in which the LLM coordinates interacting units based on heterogeneous operational context, while task-specific controllers or optimizers generate executable and constraint-aware actions. We further introduce Continuation-Aware GRPO to capture the consequences of coordination decisions over subsequent control intervals. Rather than judging a decision only by its immediate outcome, the method also evaluates how the system evolves afterward under the current policy. We validate the framework on multi-ramp traffic control and virtual power plant (VPP) energy management, using simplified system models for training and more realistic simulators for evaluation. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的分层协调控制与连续感知策略学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：在复杂工程系统中，当系统交互难以建模、运行信息异构且底层动作必须满足严格约束时，协调多个交互单元具有挑战性。我们提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的分层框架，其中LLM根据异构运行上下文协调交互单元，而任务特定的控制器或优化器生成可执行且符合约束的动作。我们进一步引入了连续感知GRPO方法，以捕捉协调决策在后续控制区间内的后果。该方法不仅根据决策的即时结果进行评判，还评估在当前策略下系统随后的演化情况。我们在多匝道交通控制和虚拟电厂（VPP）能源管理上验证了该框架，使用简化系统模型进行训练，并使用更真实的模拟器进行评估。跨所有...
tldr: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型的分层协调控制框架，结合连续感知策略学习，通过评估协调决策的长期后果，在复杂系统中实现约束感知的可执行动作生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-based hierarchical coordination control framework with continuation-aware policy learning, which evaluates long-term consequences of coordination decisions to generate executable, constraint-aware actions in complex systems.
